Chapter 1306 - 47: The Source Of The Demonic Calamity

Chapter 1306: Chapter 47: The Source of the Demonic Calamity

Demonic Qi drifted, exuding an endless dark aura.

In stark contrast to the previous blinding light.

Lin Yuan looked up at the ’Lord of Heaven Light’, falling into a brief silence.

At this moment, the ’Lord of Heaven Light’ was almost indistinguishable from the rampaging ’Demon God’ outside.

The only difference was that the Demon God’s gaze was hollow.

But now, the ’Lord of Heaven Light’ was incomparably indifferent.

Unrelated to hollow.

"The Demon God is the Lord of Heaven Light?"

Lin Yuan arrived at a definite conclusion.

Having witnessed the transformation of the Lord of Heaven Light into the Demon God, if Lin Yuan was still uncertain, he would indeed be foolish.

In fact, Lin Yuan had previously speculated whether the so-called Demon God was actually one of this world’s Eternal Lords.

Or simply the Lord of Heaven Light, but this speculation had not been deepened. After all, how could the mental will of such a powerful temporal being as the Lord of Heaven Light be eradicated and driven by instinct?

Temporal beings see through multiple future timelines; erasing the mental will of such a being is incredibly difficult, let alone for a being like the Lord of Heaven Light, who might be a Time Lord?

Not to mention erasing a Time Lord’s mental will; as soon as the thought arises in your mind, numerous future timelines spin out, and it’s likely seen by the Time Lord, who would then take the first move.

Why did the five other ancestors of the first source world apart from the Ancestor of Fierce Sun have such attitudes towards Lin Yuan?

Is it because they are inherently kind? Naturally not, but because they realized they had no way to prevent Lin Yuan’s rise.

Any timeline where Lin Yuan could be snuffed out successfully is a battle between the six ancestors, where the Ancestor of Fierce Sun would definitely protect Lin Yuan.

But the other ancestors might not share this thought.

"No wonder the Eternal Lords didn’t disclose the real reason for the disaster’s arrival."

Lin Yuan appeared thoughtful.

Who is the Lord of Heaven Light? He was the first Eternal Lord of this Fang Yuan World, who laid the foundation for the Rune cultivation system.

In the beginning of heaven and earth’s creation, the Lord of Heaven Light enlightened all sentient beings, and it can be said that the thirteen Eternal Lords born later were all beneficiaries of his grace.

Without the Lord of Heaven Light, the number of thirteen Eternal Lords would be substantially reduced, and the cultivation system of this world could never reach the flourishing state before the great change in heaven and earth.

It can be said that, in the hearts of all sentient beings, including the disciples of the significant Eternal Sects, there is a special sentiment towards the Lord of Heaven Light, both reverent and intimate, reaching a degree of fervent faith.

Once it is known that the source of the world-ending disaster originates from the Lord of Heaven Light, it is likely that many strong individuals would be thrown into mental turmoil, losing the resolve to resist the disaster.

It is precisely out of this consideration that the Eternal Lords left no information and kept absolute secrecy for the Eternal Sects they founded.

"Perhaps the Eternal Lords also do not want all beings to know about the Lord of Heaven Light’s transformation into the Destructive Demon God..."

Lin Yuan sighed inwardly, undoubtedly, the thirteen Eternal Lords were also grateful for the guidance of the Lord of Heaven Light.

Such a being, appearing in front of all beings as an infinitely bright figure, the thirteen Eternal Lords possibly do not wish to see the Lord of Heaven Light reviled and resented by all beings.

"Why did the Lord of Heaven Light’s mental will ultimately disappear, was it eradicated or due to other circumstances?" Lin Yuan pondered.

Until now, he was uncertain whether the Lord of Heaven Light was alive or dead, but at least one thing was clear, the other had not foreseen their own body becoming an instinctual threat to the source world.

Otherwise, they should have made preparations in advance, such as temporarily sealing the body and waiting for the mental will to return, and so on.

But for a temporal being suspected to be a Time Lord to not foresee their future in this way, the levels involved in this are likely extremely secretive even at the thirteenth-tier of temporal being.

"Let it be."

"Whether the Lord of Heaven Light is the Demon God has little to do with me."

Lin Yuan shook his head; he felt no special sentiment towards the Lord of Heaven Light, just a degree of admiration.

What of the other’s image? Savior or Destructive Demon God, neither affects Lin Yuan.

...

Beneath the heavens, the Lord of Heaven Light, now transformed into the Demon God, continued to speak, "I laid the foundations with Rune, creating two true forms: one of light, the other of the Black Demon. Naturally, the power of the light form surpasses the Black Demon form considerably."

Lin Yuan listened quietly; below the level of temporal beings, there is no concept of two true forms; Lin Yuan too, by using the power of the Myriad Realms Gate, at the cost of a small part of his mental will, achieved the present three true forms of his original self.

What is a true form? The true form is singular, everything else besides the true form is a clone.

There is a causal relationship between the true form and the clones.

However, between true forms, they are completely independent entities without causality.

If not seeing with his own eyes the transformation of the Lord of Heaven Light into the Demon God, Lin Yuan would not have affirmed the two belonged to the same life.

Lin Yuan comprehended the Rune legacy left by the Lord of Heaven Light, which created a slight causal relationship.

Having battled with the Demon God, he also established a new causality.

But these two causations are entirely independent.

This is one of the reasons why Lin Yuan had not previously suspected the Demon God was the Lord of Heaven Light.

"The Rune Dao encompasses all things. I believe that reaching the ultimate level, one can achieve ’Omnipotence’," the Lord of Heaven Light’s tone fluctuated.

"Omnipotence..."

Lin Yuan appeared deeply thoughtful; the ultimate pursuit of this Eternal Lord, the Lord of Heaven Light, is ’Omnipotence’, through Rune ’Omnipotence’.
